  "phoneNote": "The oversized framed introduction fills the first screen, pushing the shop photography below the fold and delaying the visual appeal of the products.",

    "Rework the mobile hero: reduce the headline size, olive illustration and frame padding, place the location beneath the headline, and bring a meaningful portion of the shop photo into the first screen.",
